title: eludite.navigation.type_hierarchy input
description: View Type Hierarchy: show the type at `line`, `column` (or the caret) in the Type Hierarchy window with its base types and derived types (`textDocument/prepareTypeHierarchy`, `typeHierarchy/supertypes`, `typeHierarchy/subtypes`); expand a node, or navigate to one.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

expand.description: Expand node `expand` in `direction` instead of starting again.
